newsitem.title: CHINA: China futures turnover 2.9 trln yuan in first half.
newsitem.headline: China futures turnover 2.9 trln yuan in first half.

text.p: Total turnover on China's futures markets totalled 2.894 trillion yuan (US$348.744 billion) in the first half of this year, slightly down from the year-ago period, the Futures Herald said on Thursday.
The fall in futures turnover was because of surging interest in the stock markets and government policy limiting state-owned enterprises from engaging in futures, the newspaper said.
Trade volume on the China Commodity Futures Exchange in the southern island province of Hainan reached 829.177 billion yuan in the first half, the highest in China, it said.
It was followed by the Zhengzhou Commodity Exchange, with a transaction volume of 721.088 billion yuan, it said.

Turnover in the second half on China's 14 futures exchanges would show little change compared with the first half, reaching about three trillion yuan, the newspaper said without giving further details.
